$comment: Written from crates/xenonet-model by cargo test -p xenonet-model. Change the type there, not this file.
title: An actor's gateway credentials
description: The answer to making a gateway token in XenoNet's window: the actor's id and a token that works only at XenoNet's actor gateway, once.

id.description: actor:<slug>, or @<host>:actor:<slug> from another host; the person at the console is actor:you

token.description: Shown once: a Biscuit minted at this machine and narrowed to the gateway, of which XenoNet keeps only its revocation id. It works only at XenoNet's actor gateway, as Authorization: Bearer

url.description: The gateway's address, when XenoNet knows it: where the program sends its MCP requests
